description: A floor-length plum-purple gown with a low square neckline, fitted opaque bodice, elbow-length sleeves and gold/red woven borders at neckline, sleeve hems, waist and vertical front. Two round shoulder brooches and a decorated round belt clasp are visible. A cream cloth wrap with matching woven borders rests around the forearms, and cream layered underskirt fabric and a patterned closed shoe show below the hem. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
